falsification_conditions.condition: BTC/USD closes above $73,500 on any daily candle within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A breakout above the August 2024 local high would invalidate the 'bottom_2024_aug' pattern match, which requires price to remain below prior resistance. This would signal a new uptrend, not a bottoming phase.

falsification_conditions.condition: Funding rate on BTC perpetual swaps exceeds +0.05% for 3 consecutive 8-hour intervals
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained positive funding indicates aggressive leveraged longs entering, which contradicts the HOLD signal and bottoming thesis. A bottom typically forms with negative or neutral funding, not euphoric long positioning.

falsification_conditions.condition: BTC spot ETF net outflows exceed $500M in any single trading day
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Massive institutional exodus would break the accumulation assumption underlying the bottom pattern. The August 2024 bottom was characterized by stabilizing ETF flows, not panic selling.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
